# Rule sources

A rule reads the items of one source: `item.<field>` in `match`, `{field}` in `title`, `explain` and `fix`.
Each item is a flat map with the fields below; examples come from the tests of existing rules.
`security-warden rules sources NAME` prints the same in the terminal, and `rules check` fails when a rule
uses a field that is not listed here. See [Contributing rules](contributing-rules.md) to write one.
